3. M 40.00,72.83 → move to same point (redundant)  
4. L 34.22,59.10 → line to (34.22,59.10)

So the actual connected vertices in order are:  
(50.55,76.16) → (40.00,72.83) → (34.22,59.10) → (38.51,46.47) → (49.40,60.03) → (68.54,44.66) → (72.08,58.87) → (61.72,73.75) → back to (50.55,76.16)

1. (50.55,76.16)
